metadata.title: Thukpa | Tibetan Noodle Soup
metadata.description:
Thukpa is a simple to prepare yet hearty noodle soup dish, which is originally from Tibet, it's also made in Northern Nepal, Bhutan and Northeastern India. 

Thukpa is generally served with meat and vegetables and is warming and comforting on a rainy or cold day. No wonder they are becoming quite popular in the rest of India.
